## Pull Request Checklist

Please review and check the following items before submitting your PR:

- [ ] **Tests**: I have added tests that cover my changes
- [ ] **Changelog**: I have updated the appropriate CHANGELOG.md file
- [ ] **Documentation**: I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] **ADR**: I have created or updated an ADR if this is an architectural change
- [ ] **Breaking Changes**: I have documented any breaking changes
- [ ] **Security**: I have considered security implications of my changes
